## Which shots survive the playoffs?

Change in points per shot from the regular season to the playoffs, by shot zone (NBA, every season).
Below zero = the shot got worse in the playoffs.

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from _viz import show, read, SERIES, line, end_labels
z = read("step5_playoff_zone_by_season.csv")
z = z[z.league == "NBA"]
fig = go.Figure()
zones = ["three", "rim", "paint / short mid", "long mid"]
ends = {}
for zone, col in zip(zones, SERIES):
    d = z[z.zone == zone].sort_values("season")
    line(fig, d.season, d.pps_change, zone, col, hovertemplate=zone + ": %{y:+.3f}<extra></extra>")
    ends[zone] = d.pps_change.iloc[-1]
end_labels(fig, ends, z.season.max(), 0.012)
fig.add_hline(y=0, line=dict(color="#8a8984", width=1))
fig.update_layout(height=420, yaxis_title="playoff minus regular-season pts/shot",
                  margin=dict(r=120, t=40), xaxis=dict(range=[z.season.min() - 0.5, z.season.max() + 0.5]))
show(fig)
```

```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown
r = read("step5_playoff_zone_resilience.csv").dropna(subset=["pps_change"])
r = r[["league", "zone", "seasons", "pps_change", "lo95", "hi95", "seasons_worse_in_playoffs"]].round(3)
r["seasons_worse_in_playoffs"] = r.seasons_worse_in_playoffs.map(lambda x: "" if x != x else f"{x:.0%}")
Markdown(r.to_markdown(index=False))
```

## Champion profiles by era

Share of champions that had each ingredient: a primary scorer, a secondary scorer, a floor-spacing big and
a perimeter defender. The ingredients are loose definitions meant to show drift, not a recipe.

```{python}
e = read("step5_champions_by_era.csv")
cols = {"C1_primary_scorer": "primary scorer", "C2_secondary_scorer": "secondary scorer", "C3_spacing_big": "spacing big",
        "C4_perimeter_d": "perimeter defender", "n_high_usage": "high-usage players", "team_three_diet": "three-point diet"}
Markdown(e[["league", "era", *cols]].rename(columns=cols).round(2).to_markdown(index=False))
```

## Does roster mix predict titles better than team strength?

Forward-chained test (train on past seasons, predict the next champion). Higher log-likelihood is better.

```{python}
t = read("step5_B_title_cv.csv")
Markdown(t[["league", "model", "test_seasons", "mean_loglik_champion", "uniform_baseline_loglik", "mean_prob_on_champion"]].round(3).to_markdown(index=False))
```
